زَاهِرٌ [Shining; &c. See 1.] ―
-b2- Applied to a زَنْد, or piece of stick, or wood, for producing fire, Emitting shining fire; making its fire to shine. (TA.) ―
-b3- Applied to a plant, (assumed tropical:) Beautiful: and to the complexion of a man, bright; shining: and i. q. أَزْهَرُ, q. v. (TA.) ―
-b4- أَحْمَرُ زَاهِرٌ (assumed tropical:) Intensely red. (Lh, K.) ―
-b5- لِفُلَانٍ دَوْلَةٌ زَاهِرَةٌ (tropical:) [Such a one has a brilliant turn of fortune]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
